## 6. Function

Implement exactly this behaviour (from the reference program's documentation):

```text
Usage: python3 ip/scripts/make_dataflow_diagrams.py [--only NAME ...] [--no-svg]
```

Per function:

```text
bus_info: (prefix, protocol family, member) of a protocol-bus port, else None.

is_clock_or_reset: Clocks and resets reach almost every block: listed in the title instead of drawn. Ports may use a
one-letter clock prefix (wclk, rclk); internal nets must match exactly (sclk_hi is data).

blank: Replace a match by spaces, keeping its newlines (line numbers stay valid).

preprocess: Keep only the active `ifdef / `ifndef / `elsif / `else branches (also inside one line) and record
`define. Every input line gives one output line, so line numbers stay valid.

design_defines: Defines set by the configuration files of a file list (configuration.sv ...).

bundle: Group key of a signal: the AXI / SDRAM interface prefix, else the name itself.

body_first_line: Source line number at which module_body() starts.

balanced: Text inside the parentheses that open at text[start] == '('.

without_constants: Drop typedefs, parameters and functions: their names are constants or types, not signals.

logic_text: The module's own logic: drop declarations, functions and parameters (they are not data flow).

pair_buses: Master / slave ends that share nets: one bus line each. Returns (lines, covered (net, node) pairs).

targets: (name, top module, top source, docs dir) for every IP, system, design-local IP and example.

RtlParser: Statement-level parser of a module body: which signals each assignment reads (data and the
if / case conditions around it). Constructs it does not know are skipped to the next ';'.
```
